cap_scope: This continuation only, after the previous two probes.
reservation: Before each transmission, twice the standard-price cost of settled responses plus all unsettled worst-case reservations plus the next worst-case reservation must be <= $4. Reserve uses 2x standard rates, 25% + 256 prompt-token allowance, and max output. Unused reservation is released only after usage arrives. No automatic retries.
selection: First recipe clean on 3 screen items plus 5 validation items on two draws; order fixed before inference, never select by accuracy. Separate held-out main items.
main: 5 held-out items/depth, 2 draws at 7,9,11; predefined downward expansion to 5 and 6; one additional post-declared depth4 anchor, recorded in continuation_budget_revision.json.
invalid_policy: Screen failures reject a recipe, not the whole search. Nontruncated main reasoned rows score wrong; truncated/blind rows are missing. >20% invalid among scorable rows marks unmeasured; >20% missing is separately flagged as incomplete.
fresh_control: One max-effort control on a screening item; counter must be present and >0.
structural_caveat: These synthetic sensitivity-filtered diagnostic depths are not the normalized 7.2-step metric.
